FlowerPainter.Recipe.UrbanRuins.Descript: A skate spot among the ruins of a broken-down highway: pillars, fallen deck, DIY ramps, graffiti and dirt jumps.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.Name: Urban ruins
FlowerPainter.Ruins.subtype.Tooltip: What the ruins became. Each type lays the spot out differently.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.skateItems.Tooltip: Ramps, rails and boxes in lines on the pads under the highway; ramps at the ends face in.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.graffiti.Tooltip: Graffiti on pillars, walls, blocks and along the pads.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.decay.Tooltip: How ruined it is: rubble on the fallen spans, cracks, faded markings.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.overgrowth.Tooltip: Wild plants reclaiming the edges and the fallen deck.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.deck.Tooltip: The old highway line: pillar pairs, spans that stand or have fallen.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.deckSide.Tooltip: Through the middle, or along one side leaving a big yard.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.collapse.Tooltip: Share of spans that fell: broken asphalt, tilted slabs and rubble on the ground, stumps for pillars.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.embankment.Tooltip: An earth on-ramp rising towards a broken-off end (permanent terraform).
FlowerPainter.Ruins.markings.Tooltip: Faded lane markings on the fallen carriageway.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.padShare.Tooltip: Concrete pads under the standing spans where the skaters built their spot.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.ledges.Tooltip: Concrete blocks and barriers dragged onto the pads as ledges.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.bowl.Tooltip: A dug bowl in a pad (permanent terraform). 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.jumpLines.Tooltip: BMX dirt-jump lines (take-off and landing mounds) in the yard.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.blocks.Tooltip: A field of concrete blocks of different sizes on gravel.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.walls.Tooltip: Free-standing legal walls in a zig-zag row, painted on both sides.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.fenceGaps.Tooltip: Share of fence panels that are missing.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.Issue.NoDeck: The area is too narrow for the highway line.
FlowerPainter.Ruins.Issue.Fewer: Only {0} of {1} fit in the yard.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DirtJumps.Name: Dirt jumps
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DirtJumps.height.Too: Height of the take-off mounds (permanent terraform).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DirtJumps.jumps.Tool: Take-off/landing pairs per line (fewer when they do not fit).
A taller hill at the start of each line to build speed.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DirtJumps.paintLayer: Which of the map's four extra terrain textures to paint.
FlowerPainter.AddOn.DirtJumps.Issue.NoPl: No free ground was big enough for the dirt jumps.
